summary: SMB customer (chat-first support app) on Hosted API complaining about EU latency/timeouts. Self-serve lead, cost sensitive. Wants short-term tuning guidance (region, timeouts, prompt size) before committing to larger usage.
recommended_actions: Run RTT comparison: eu-central-1 vs eu-west-1 vs us-west-2 from their EU and NA client locations
Advise client timeout = 15s to start; use streaming to surface partial responses earlier; set per-request max_wait to 10s for user-facing calls
Reduce total prompt tokens: move static system prompts to server-side prefix cache or shortened templates
Enable response streaming + client-side incremental rendering to avoid UX timeouts
For repeated context, use KV/prefix caching to avoid re-sending long history each turn
If sustained load, recommend switching to a nearby Redwood region or explore Dedicated once usage justifies reserved capacity
